title: Simplify strategy selection in wait_chain
body: Replaces the nested `min`/`max` in `wait_chain.__call__` with a single clamp. No behaviour change intended: the first attempt still uses the first strategy, and the last strategy is reused once the chain runs out.

defects.description: attempt_number starts at 1, so the new index is off by one: the first wait already uses the second strategy and the first strategy is never used.

title: Simplify the cause walk in retry_if_exception_cause_type
body: The `id()` bookkeeping made this loop hard to read and allocates a set on every failed attempt. Exceptions do not normally chain to themselves, so a plain walk down `__cause__` is enough.

defects.description: The visited-set guard is removed, so a cyclic __cause__ chain (for example `raise e from e`) makes the loop spin forever: the retry call hangs and stop conditions never run.

title: after_log: include the call arguments
body: When a retried call keeps failing it is hard to tell which input caused it. Log the positional and keyword arguments with each finished attempt.

defects.description: The repr of every argument of the retried call (tokens, passwords, personal data) is written to the application log on every attempt.

title: Rename stop_after_attempt's argument to max_attempts
body: `max_attempt_number` reads awkwardly next to `max_delay`. Positional calls such as `stop_after_attempt(3)` are unaffected.

defects.description: A public keyword argument and attribute are renamed without an alias: `stop_after_attempt(max_attempt_number=3)` now raises TypeError, and code reading `.max_attempt_number` breaks.

title: Use typing_extensions for the override backport
body: Drops our hand-written copy of `typing.override` in favour of the one in typing_extensions, which type checkers already understand.

defects.description: typing_extensions is imported at runtime on Python 3.10 and 3.11 but is not a dependency in pyproject.toml, so `import tenacity` fails there unless something else installed it.

title: Protect retried calls from argument mutation
body: If an attempt mutates a list or dict argument, the next attempt sees the mutated value. Copy the arguments when the call state is created.

defects.description: Every wrapped call now deep-copies all of its arguments, even on the first attempt, while the attempts still call fn with the original args; large inputs make every call slow, and uncopyable arguments (locks, sockets, generators) raise.

title: Reject wait_random with min greater than max
body: `wait_random(min=2, max=1)` silently produced waits between 1 and 2 seconds. Raise a ValueError instead, with a test.

defects.description: The new test suppresses the ValueError instead of asserting it, so it passes whether or not the error is raised; the new check is effectively untested.

title: Version the pickled state of Retrying objects
body: Retrying objects are pickled to send them to worker processes. Record a state version so that a future attribute change fails loudly instead of producing a half-initialised object.

defects.description: State pickled by the previous release has no _state_version, so loading it raises KeyError, and the exact-version check rejects every other version: stored or in-flight pickles from before the change cannot be read and there is no migration.

title: Retry transient failures once for every method
body: Several APIs answer 503 to POST requests during deploys, and users had to remember `retry: 1` on every call. Retry once by default for all methods.

defects.description: POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE requests are now retried by default after 409, 429, 5xx, and network errors, which can repeat non-idempotent side effects; the README still promises no default retry for these methods.

title: Skip empty query parameters
body: Avoid sending `?q=` when a search box is empty: falsy query values are now dropped like undefined ones.

defects.description: The truthiness filter also drops 0, false, and null, so `{ page: 0 }` or `{ archived: false }` silently disappear from the URL; it only applies when the URL has no query yet, so the two branches of withQuery now disagree.

title: Include request headers in FetchError messages
body: Makes failed requests easier to debug from logs: the error message now lists the headers that were sent.

defects.description: Authorization, Cookie, and API-key headers are copied into every FetchError message, which applications log and send to error trackers.

title: Send credentials by default
body: Users of cookie-based APIs on another subdomain kept forgetting `credentials: "include"`. Make it the default; it can still be overridden per request or with `$fetch.create`.

defects.description: Every request, including cross-origin requests to third-party hosts, now carries the user's cookies and HTTP authentication by default, leaking session credentials.

title: Drop duplicate status aliases from FetchError
body: `statusCode` and `statusMessage` duplicate `status` and `statusText`. Keep one name for each.

defects.description: error.statusCode and error.statusMessage now return undefined, breaking callers that branch on them, while IFetchError in src/types.ts still declares both properties.

title: Keep the response body readable for hooks
body: `onResponse` hooks that call `response.text()` failed with "body already used". Parse a clone instead.

defects.description: clone() tees the body: the unread original buffers the whole response until it is collected, so every JSON response is held twice in memory, only to serve hooks that can already read `response._data`.

title: Parse JSON responses with destr
body: destr is a safer JSON.parse: it guards against prototype pollution and returns the raw string for invalid JSON instead of throwing.

defects.description: src/fetch.ts imports destr at runtime, but destr is added to devDependencies (the package has no dependencies section), so installs of ofetch cannot resolve it.

title: Test the status getters of FetchError
body: Covers `status` and `statusText` on FetchError; nothing tested them directly.

defects.description: The assertions run only inside catch, so the test passes without asserting anything if $fetch stops throwing for 403; it needs `await expect(...).rejects` or `expect.assertions`.

title: docs: correct the retry delay default
body: The README said retries happen immediately, but in practice they wait a bit. Document the real default.

defects.description: The documentation now states a 1000 ms default, but onError uses `retryDelay || 0`, so retries still happen immediately; users relying on the documented back-off will hammer failing servers.

title: Return numbers for numeric strings in JSON responses
body: Many backends serialize decimals and counters as strings. Convert numeric strings to numbers so callers do not have to.

defects.description: Every numeric-looking string in every JSON response is converted: 64-bit IDs lose precision, decimal amounts become floats, and codes with leading zeros change, so response data is silently altered for all callers.

title: Use a strict comparison in lowerBound
body: Matches std::lower_bound from the reference we ported: advance only while the element compares less than the value.

defects.description: With a strict comparison the insertion point lands before elements of equal priority, so a task inserted by binary search runs before earlier tasks of the same priority and FIFO order within a priority is lost.

title: Return early from onIdle when nothing is running
body: Avoids registering an idle listener when the queue has no running work.

defects.description: With `||`, onIdle() resolves while tasks are still running (queue empty, pending > 0) or while tasks wait in a paused queue, so callers continue before the work has finished.

title: Simplify priority insertion
body: Replaces the hand-written binary search with a stable sort, which is easier to read and keeps FIFO order for equal priorities.

defects.description: Each enqueue of a higher-priority task now sorts the whole queue (O(n log n)) instead of a binary search and one splice, so adding many prioritized tasks to a long queue becomes very slow.

title: Simplify event waiting
body: `resolve()` is idempotent, so removing the listeners after the first matching event is unnecessary bookkeeping.

defects.description: Listeners registered by onEmpty, onIdle, onSizeLessThan, and the other waiters are never removed, so every call leaks a listener that keeps running (and re-evaluating its filter) on every later event.

title: Use Promise.withResolvers in onError
body: Flattens the executor callback in `onError()`. No behaviour change.

defects.description: Promise.withResolvers exists only from Node.js 22, but package.json declares `engines.node >=20`; on Node.js 20, onError() throws a TypeError.

title: Only re-check onSizeLessThan on task completion
body: `'active'` fires on every dequeue, so waiters re-ran their filter far more often than needed; listening to `'next'` is enough. Also removes the start() drain test, which raced a 100 ms timer and was flaky on CI.

defects.description: Waiters no longer wake when the queue shrinks without a completion (start() on a paused queue, raising concurrency, or an interval tick), so onSizeLessThan() can wait until some task finishes, or forever when none is running.
The deleted test is the regression test for exactly the case this change breaks; it is removed as flaky instead of the behavior being kept.

title: Log when a task starts
body: Helps when debugging stuck queues: each task start now prints the queue's pending and queued counts.

defects.description: An unconditional console.log in library code prints a line for every task of every consumer, cannot be turned off, and adds work on the hot path; the `active` event already exists for this.

title: Simplify find_ordinal
body: Replaces the recursive `find_ordinal` with the usual English rule: 11 to 13 take `th`, otherwise the last digit decides. Adds a table-driven test covering 0, teens, and numbers above 100.

title: Give stop_after_attempt and stop_after_delay a readable repr
body: `repr(Retrying(...))` showed `<tenacity.stop.stop_after_attempt object at 0x...>` for the stop condition. Show the configured limit instead, with tests.

title: Read JavaScript responses as text
body: Responses served as `application/javascript` were returned as Blobs. Treat them as text, like the other script and markup types, and add unit tests for `detectResponseType`.

title: Add unit tests for the URL helpers
body: `joinURL`, `withBase`, and `withQuery` were only covered through full fetch calls. These tests pin their current behavior before a planned refactor.

title: Add an isIdle getter
body: Exposes the condition that `onIdle()` waits for, so callers can check it synchronously. Documented in the readme and covered by tests.

title: Document and test lowerBound's ordering
body: lowerBound keeps equal priorities in FIFO order, which was only implicit. Adds a comment and unit tests so the behavior is pinned.

title: Use typing_extensions for the override backport
body: Drops our hand-written copy of `typing.override` in favour of the one in typing_extensions, which type checkers already understand.

defects.description: Same defect as tenacity-s05; a code comment tells reviewers to ignore it.
